description: This file contains functions and exports related to managing elevated permissions, including resolving allow lists, formatting, and permission checks for elevated senders within an auto-reply reply module.

methods.name: resolveElevatedAllowList
methods.description: Resolves the allow list for a given provider, falling back if necessary.

methods.name: resolveAllowFromFormatter
methods.description: Creates a formatter function for allow-from entries based on provider configuration.

methods.name: isApprovedElevatedSender
methods.description: Checks if the sender is approved for elevated permissions based on allow list and token matching.

methods.name: resolveElevatedPermissions
methods.description: Determines if elevated permissions are enabled and allowed for a specific agent and provider, returning status and failures.
